Wire hook into C:/Users/wompu/.claude/settings.json UserPromptSubmit chain after master-index-precheck-inject (mirrored auto to H:/.claude/settings.json by c-to-h-mirror)
Regen _skill-triggers.jsonl so /audit-viz-first surfaces on audit keywords
